observations.title: README 3.1 overstates what attempt1 executed for the empty-selection no-op
observations.detail: README 3.1 says the attempt1 product no-op assertions all held: two renderers returned Ok (each twice), three channel buffers were not allocated, no readable output, no panic. Independently checked against the pre-A2 test source (5a6b6c33:tests/support/render_bvh/r08_gpu.rs L259-311) and the attempt1 log: the Ok assertions are mega x2 + depth_seg x1 (three calls, not two each); the is_enabled=false asserts (L270-279) ran and passed before the render; the read().is_err() asserts (L298-307) sit AFTER the failing memory assert (L296), so attempt1 never executed them and never printed r08[empty] (confirmed: the log has no r08[empty] line). Those read-output assertions are verified only in attempt2.
